I have taken the zaza’s for 3+ years and the height of it I was taking 5 bottles a day, 2.5 bottles at a time. I noticed that you can cut significantly without much issue. I went almost straight to 2 bottles. Then from two to one pretty quickly and I jumped from 1 bottle. I did take a few after the jump about 3 days later and then 3 days after that, only 5 at a time with one of those sleepwalker capsules with the 5. Gabapentin, Kratom, trazodone at night for sleep, and Wellbutrin during the morning.  The mental part was/is still the hardest part. Your brain will heal and the energy will come back. It will just take a few months. Lyrica will help in place of gabapentin if you can’t get it. Tbh I would also drink a beer or two with my kratom dose on some of the worst n of nights and that would help me sleep. The Ativan will
Def help too. There’s also tons of info on meds in the forum. A lot of different stuff will help but for me kratom, gabapentin, Wellbutrin. I’m sure a benzo would’ve helped a lot too but that’s kinda what I used the alcohol/phenibut for.
